purpose: Teach: 参事官/占有/便宜/納付/受託/公然/始動/散会

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、外務省の参事官と打ち合わせを行え
lines.en: Coordinate a meeting with the Foreign Ministry counselor.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Matter-of-fact delivery with no room for negotiation. Eyes steady, chin level. Each word lands with equal weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。倉庫の占有面積を整理しました
lines.en: Yes. I've organized the warehouse storage allocation.
lines.style: Respectful but confident. Straightforward tone reporting completed work. Slight formal lift on the acknowledgment, then settle into the briefing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、お得意様には便宜を図れ
lines.en: Make sure we facilitate what our key clients need.
lines.style: Direct instruction, no softening. Lean forward slightly. Implied weight behind the words — this is important. Steady gaze.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。税金の納付期限を確認しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm confirming the tax payment deadlines now.
lines.style: Professional reassurance. Calm, ongoing-work tone. Slightly deferential without being obsequious. Shows competence through steadiness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新規受託業務を増やせ
lines.style: Command with expectation built in. Short, efficient. No explanation needed — the order is clear. Slight pause after, as if waiting for acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品の公然たる発表をいたしました
lines.en: Yes. We've made the public announcement of the new product.
lines.style: Professional completion report. Slight pride in 'made' — task finished well. Steady pace, formal register maintained throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新システムを始動しろ
lines.style: Final directive, crisper than before. Imperative, no room for questions. Voice carries finality — meeting nearly over, this is the last order.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。今日の会議は無事散会いたしました
lines.style: Closing acknowledgment. Slight softening compared to earlier updates — meeting is wrapping. Respectful, clear finality. Slight bow in the voice.
